items.heading: High Score
items.text: High score: You usually have some energy left after the day, your days off help you recover, and you can stay with a task without your mind going flat.

items.heading: Low Score
items.text: Low score: You often feel emptied out early in the day, dread the start of it, or find that days off do not bring your energy back.
